description: This file is a base class for API tests in the OrangeHRM project. It sets up configuration and API client objects for testing purposes, handling 'discovery-only' mode and environment variable requirements.

classes.name: BaseApiTest
classes.description: Abstract class serving as a foundational setup for API testing, managing configuration and API client initialization, with considerations for discovery mode.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes configuration and API client objects before each test, considering discovery mode and environment variables.

methods.name: guardDiscoveryOnly
methods.description: Ensures environment variables are set when not in discovery-only mode, asserting required URLs are available.
